headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers 7-1, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Harrison Bader of the San Francisco Giants, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis. The Colorado Rockies' Welinton Herrera is also out with left elbow inflammation, while the Athletics' Luis Severino is on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder strain. The Cincinnati Reds' Pierce Johnson has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 27, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The Detroit Tigers have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of LHP Juanmi Vasquez in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The Blue Jays received RHP Connor Seabold in return. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox cruised to a 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Brad Lord earning the win after 2.0 innings of scoreless relief. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 7-6 decision to the Texas Rangers, coming up just one run short. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 strong innings for the Jays.

top_news.title: **Giants Place CF Harrison Bader on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants center fielder Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis. The injury occurred on May 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
